_note: The trains crews are actually called for at the three pilot running rooms.
Built from the division's own working-timetable summary and train master:
Train_Timings_Summary.xlsx (times at IGATPURI, LONAVLA and ROHA) and
div_trains_stations.csv (names and run days). Nothing here is invented.
UP is the working a rested crew is CALLED FOR at these rooms -- he came down,
was relieved, slept, and works back towards Mumbai. The DN rows are how he
arrived, and they are shipped inactive: they become live the day Bhusawal's
crews rest here and are called for DN trains onward. Switch them on under
Trains on the sheet, or re-import with --direction BOTH.
sign_on_time is the train's time at this station less 60 minutes. There is no
figure in the tender for the lead; it is a convenience for pre-filling the
sheet and the bearer overwrites it with what the lobby actually says.
